CoursePage.title: Sidebar scroll position resets on tab switch
CoursePage.function: Scroll position tracking for the course file list.
CoursePage.error: Switching tabs and back resets scroll to top instead of preserving position.

CoursePage.title: Add search bar to course file list
CoursePage.function: Filter visible files by name as the user types.
CoursePage.error: No way to quickly find a file in a long course list.
CoursePage.solution: Added debounced input above the file tree, filters on label match.

CoursePage.title: Markdown viewer code blocks overflow on mobile
CoursePage.error: Long lines push past the viewport width on narrow screens, no horizontal scroll.

CoursePage.title: PDF viewer page jump input
CoursePage.function: Direct page number entry to jump to a specific page.
CoursePage.error: Only prev/next buttons existed, slow for long PDFs.
CoursePage.solution: Added numeric input with enter-to-jump and bounds clamping.

DeadlinesPage.title: Deadline sort order flips after edit
DeadlinesPage.error: Editing a deadline's date does not re-sort the list until page reload.

DeadlinesPage.title: Priority badge on deadline cards
DeadlinesPage.function: Visual priority indicator on each deadline.
DeadlinesPage.error: No quick way to see which deadlines are high priority at a glance.
DeadlinesPage.solution: Added colored badge driven by the priority field, high/normal/low.

DeadlinesPage.title: Study heatmap dead cells miscounted at month boundary
DeadlinesPage.function: Grid layout for the yearly study activity heatmap.
DeadlinesPage.error: First week of a new month sometimes shows one extra dead cell before the first live day.

DeadlinesPage.title: Mark deadline done from card directly
DeadlinesPage.function: One-click done toggle on each deadline card.
DeadlinesPage.error: Marking a deadline done required opening an edit modal.
DeadlinesPage.solution: Added checkbox on the card that toggles the done field directly.

OsHubPage.title: Resource links open in same tab
OsHubPage.error: Clicking a resource link navigates away instead of opening a new tab.

OsHubPage.title: Category filter for resources
OsHubPage.error: All resources were shown in one long unfiltered list.
OsHubPage.solution: Added category chips above the list, click to filter.

OsHubPage.title: Broken image icon on missing thumbnail
OsHubPage.error: Resources without a thumbnail show a broken image icon instead of a placeholder.
